create.name: Ken Page
create.bio:
Ken Page is a New York author, coach and licensed clinical social worker whose teaching centres on intimacy and the search for lasting love as a path of inner growth. He began Deeper Dating in 2004 as a series of evening events, offered as a warmer alternative to bars and speed dating, where trained facilitators spoke about intimacy, sexuality and spirit before guiding guests through exercises together. His book Deeper Dating, published by Shambhala, grew out of that work, and he has led workshops at places such as the Omega Institute, the Garrison Institute and Columbia University.

At the heart of his approach is the idea of Core Gifts: the qualities people often feel most tender or insecure about are, he suggests, the places where their deepest warmth and aliveness live. Students learn to notice which attractions lead towards kindness and which towards old pain, and to let themselves be seen for who they are. He shares the work through the weekly Deeper Dating Podcast, a self-paced video course and a six-month mentorship intensive for small groups, and he trains Deeper Dating mentors. He lives in Long Beach, New York, with his husband and their children.

books.title: Deeper Dating: How to Drop the Games of Seduction and Discover the Power of Intimacy
books.author: Ken Page
books.description: Ken Page's guide to looking for love by valuing, rather than hiding, the most sensitive parts of yourself. It sets out his Core Gifts idea and practical steps for telling healthy attraction from attraction that repeats old hurt.

courses.title: Deeper Dating: A Step-by-Step Path to Lifelong Love (Video Course)
courses.description: A self-paced online video course that walks through the whole Deeper Dating method, from spotting the attractions that bring pain to leading with your Core Gifts. Lifetime access to the recorded lessons.

courses.title: Deeper Dating Mentorship Intensive
courses.description: A six-month small-group programme with personal coaching from Ken Page, for people who have done a good deal of inner work and want to find a lasting partner. Entry begins with a free exploratory call.

free_resources.title: Deeper Dating Podcast
free_resources.description: Ken Page's weekly podcast on intimacy and dating, free to read or listen to on his site. This episode gives a twenty-minute overview of the whole Deeper Dating approach.
